newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco Group Three low sulphur diesel firms.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco Group Three low sulphur diesel firms.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel basis firmed in the Group Three spot market as sellers pushed asking prices higher on rumors of strong refiner buying in the Gulf Coast spot market, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel was talked at bids 2.0 cents a gallon under the print with sellers asking 1.50 cents under. But traders appeared hesitant in the face of weakening NYMEX February heating oil.
Group Three unleaded gasoline basis also firmed, with a deal heard done at 1.45 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in morning trade in the Midwest market.
Midwest traders said refiners Exxon and Citgo were sighted buying in the Gulf Coast spot market.

Some traders were mystified at the firming Group Three differentials coming in the wake of reports the Williams pipeline system contained a 25-day supply of gasoline and 46-day supply of low-sulphur diesel.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was talked 4.0/3.75 cents a gallon under the print, and unleaded in Chicago was steady at 2.0/1.75 cents a gallon under, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was steady at 8.25 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 5.50 cents under the print in Chicago, traders said.
